title: 2017 Bowman Draft Chrome Refractor Matt Tabor #BDC-168 Arizona Diamondbacks
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2017 Bowman Draft Chrome Refractor card features Matt Tabor of the Arizona Diamondbacks. The card is a single-parallel and has the card number #BDC-168. It is an original card manufactured by Bowman. 

The card is part of the Draft series and is a sports trading card for baseball fans. The card is modern, manufactured in 2017, and is an original print. The card features a refractor design and is perfect for collectors. Add this card to your collection today!
